key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure (+30c/L)
ANZ.AX axing 3,500 jobs signals structural cost pressure across banking sector
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
Housing market bifurcating: high-end crash while affordable segment resilient; no spring auction bounce
Oil price surge from failed suppression efforts lifting energy sector but hitting consumer staples
Mining cap-raise wave (Canaccord-led) signals capital stress in junior miners
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears (Santos.AX relevant)

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; junior miners scrambling for cap raises; gold/silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside from falling iron ore; gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and battery tech (Critical Resources) offer relative rotation

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs; banks tumbling alongside miners on rising bond yields; superannuation policy debate (One Nation) creating political overhang
sectors.implications: Cost-cutting may support margins short-term but signals weak loan growth; rising yields pressure equity valuations; CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australian fuel prices +30c; Santos preserved via policy concession; gas supply rules softened
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, AGL.AX benefit from higher oil/gas; consumer cost pass-through pressures WES.AX, CWP.AX margins

sectors.trend: Woolworths breached 'Price Freeze' on staples; women's clothing chain closing 177 stores; business confidence deteriorating
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CWP.AX face margin compression from input costs; discretionary consumer (WOW.AX, LPX.AX) under pressure from weak sentiment

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing at high end; no auction spring bounce; RBA watching rental inflation; first-home buyers surging into affordable segment
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals; construction (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) may see volume support from first-home buyer surge

sectors.trend: HIVE/BUZZ HPC scaling AI cloud; US quantum funding ($300M to D-Wave, Rigetti, Quantinuum); Oracle cloud beat; OpenAI security breach
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) may benefit from global AI capex cycle; cybersecurity risk elevated post-Hugging Face hack

key_themes: Rate-rise fears driving bond yield spike, pressuring growth and financial equities
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak, oil/gold strong
AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and fuel costs
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Superannuation policy debate creating political uncertainty
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and job cuts
Energy security policy shift (gas supply rules, Santos)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX, RIO.AX); diversify into gold and battery metals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA response
Shorten duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate REITs; hold cash buffer
Monitor ANZ.AX, CBA.AX earnings guidance; favour banks with diversified revenue
Avoid high-end property exposure; monitor construction and finance-linked equities
Review tech holdings for security exposure; favour established platforms over early-stage AI

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery metals on iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting creates rotation into defensive commodities; Critical Resources battery tech in month-long validation

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil surge and gas policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failure + softened gas supply rules support Santos.AX, Woodside.AX; fuel cost pass-through benefits producers
ANZ 3,500 job cuts may improve ROE; CBA/NAB with stronger loan books less exposed

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and high-beta mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Active price bloodletting; cap-raise dilution risk in juniors; $90bn ASX drawdown ongoing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk via short-duration bonds or cash
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA rental inflation concern may force hawkish pivot

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-end property and discretionary consumer
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest falls at luxury end; Woolworths price breaches signal margin pressure; business confidence weak

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Iron ore weakness, AUD depreciation, and rate-rise fears create headwinds for miners and banks. Oil/gold rotation and energy policy support provide partial offset. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US bond yield moves.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA holds. Housing bifurcation may moderate as first-home buyer surge supports volume. Superannuation policy debate could create tailwind for financials if reforms pass. AI/tech capex cycle (US quantum funding, Oracle cloud) supports selective tech exposure.

Iron ore price floor and Chinese demand data
ANZ/CBA full-year guidance post job cuts
US bond yield trajectory (Trump bond salesman narrative)
watch_list: Brent crude and Australian fuel prices
RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
NZ housing correction spillover to Australia
US quantum/AI funding flow to ASX tech
